definition: Prototype methods are machine learning methods that use data prototypes.
details: A data prototype is a data value that reflects other values in its class, e.g., the centroid in a K-means clustering problem.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. That care with the raw material is Prototype methods.
